var TCSFXLIB=(function(){

 function pan(c,p,dest){if(!c.createStereoPanner)return dest;const s=c.createStereoPanner();s.pan.value=p;s.connect(dest);return s}
  
 function env(c,dest,t,a,peak,hold,rel){const g=c.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak,t+a);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+a+hold,rel/4);g.connect(dest);return g}
 function lfo(c,f,depth,param,type,t){const o=c.createOscillator();o.type=type||'sine';o.frequency.value=f;const g=c.createGain();g.gain.value=depth;o.connect(g);g.connect(param);o.start(t||c.currentTime);return o}
 function shaper(c,k,dest){const s=c.createWaveShaper(),n=256,cu=new Float32Array(n);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=i/(n-1)*2-1;cu[i]=Math.tanh(k*x)/Math.tanh(k)}s.curve=cu;s.connect(dest);return s}
 const stopAll=(a,t)=>{for(const s of a)try{s.stop(t)}catch(e){}};
 const V=p=>p&&p.v!=null?p.v:1;
  
 function bell(c,o,t,f,v,dec,parts){for(const [k,a,tau] of parts||[[1,1,dec],[2.01,.35,dec*.5],[3.98,.12,dec*.25]]){const g=c.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*a,t+.004);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.005,tau/4);g.connect(o);osc(c,'sine',f*k,t,t+tau*1.6+.05,g)}return t+dec*1.6+.05}

 const ONE={
   
  horn(c,o,t,p){const d=p&&p.d||.45,v=V(p),lp=filt(c,'lowpass',3200,.7,o),bp=filt(c,'bandpass',1500,.6,lp),g=env(c,bp,t,.012,.16*v,d,.08);osc(c,'square',405,t,t+d+.15,g);osc(c,'square',507,t,t+d+.15,g);return t+d+.15},

   const n=env(c,filt(c,'bandpass',1400,1,o),t,.03,.22*v,d*.6,d*.5);noise(c,'pink',t,t+d+.2,n);return t+d+.2},

   const g=env(c,o,t+.02,.003,.12*v,.03,.1),s=osc(c,'triangle',240,t+.02,t+.2,g);s.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(160,t+.15);return t+.25},
  doorClose(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p);noise(c,'brown',t,t+.2,env(c,filt(c,'lowpass',260,.8,o),t,.002,.9*v,.03,.14));const g=env(c,o,t,.002,.35*v,.02,.16),s=osc(c,'sine',95,t,t+.3,g);s.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(55,t+.2);
   noise(c,'white',t+.005,t+.02,env(c,filt(c,'highpass',3000,.7,o),t+.005,.001,.18*v,.003,.015));return t+.32},
  step(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p)*(p&&p.run?1.25:1),s=p&&p.surf||'road',k=rr(.85,1.15);

    noise(c,'white',t,t+.05,env(c,filt(c,'bandpass',800*k,3,o),t,.001,.25*v,.006,.03));return t+.22}
   if(s==='grass'){noise(c,'white',t,t+.14,env(c,filt(c,'bandpass',4200*k,.8,filt(c,'highpass',1800,.5,o)),t,.012,.16*v,.03,.07));noise(c,'pink',t,t+.08,env(c,filt(c,'lowpass',500,.7,o),t,.004,.25*v,.01,.04));return t+.16}
   if(s==='sand'){for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const tt=t+i*.016*k;noise(c,'white',tt,tt+.05,env(c,filt(c,'bandpass',2100*k,1.2,o),tt,.003,.14*v*(1-i*.2),.01,.03))}noise(c,'brown',t,t+.1,env(c,filt(c,'lowpass',350,.7,o),t,.005,.35*v,.01,.05));return t+.12}
    noise(c,'white',t,t+.06,env(c,filt(c,'bandpass',1700*k,1.1,o),t,.0015,.3*v,.006,.035));const g=env(c,o,t,.002,.18*v,.005,.05),a=osc(c,'sine',120*k,t,t+.09,g);a.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(70,t+.06);return t+.1},
  splashSmall(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p),g=env(c,o,t,.02,.25*v,.04,.25),bp=filt(c,'bandpass',1600,.8,g);bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(1600,t);bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(500,t+.3);noise(c,'pink',t,t+.4,bp);return t+.42},
  cast(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p),g=env(c,o,t,.05,.25*v,.18,.15),bp=filt(c,'bandpass',600,1.4,g);bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(500,t);bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(3200,t+.32);noise(c,'white',t,t+.45,bp);
   const g2=env(c,o,t+.08,.02,.035*v,.25,.15),z=osc(c,'sine',3400,t+.08,t+.5,g2);z.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1700,t+.45);return t+.5},
  plop(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p),g=env(c,o,t,.002,.4*v,.01,.12),s=osc(c,'sine',800,t,t+.18,g);s.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(190,t+.09);
   noise(c,'white',t,t+.2,env(c,filt(c,'bandpass',1150,1.5,o),t,.003,.22*v,.02,.12));noise(c,'white',t+.04,t+.35,env(c,filt(c,'highpass',3500,.6,o),t+.04,.01,.06*v,.05,.2));return t+.36},
  reel(c,o,t,p){const d=p&&p.d||.5,v=V(p),rate=p&&p.rate||24,n=Math.max(1,Math.round(d*rate));for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const tt=t+i/rate;noise(c,'white',tt,tt+.012,env(c,filt(c,'bandpass',3600,4,o),tt,.0008,.22*v,.002,.006))}return t+d+.05},
  bite(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p);for(const dt of [0,.13]){const g=env(c,o,t+dt,.002,.25*v,.01,.07),s=osc(c,'sine',950,t+dt,t+dt+.12,g);s.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(560,t+dt+.07)}bell(c,o,t+.02,2350,.05*v,.5);return t+.6},
  splash(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p),g=c.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.45*v,t+.03);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.06,.16);g.connect(o);const bp=filt(c,'bandpass',2500,.7,g);bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(2600,t);bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(450,t+.6);noise(c,'white',t,t+1,bp);

  fishLanded(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p),e=ONE.splash(c,o,t,{v:v*.8});bell(c,o,t+.25,mtof(79),.07*v,.6);bell(c,o,t+.42,mtof(84),.08*v,.9);return Math.max(e,t+1.5)},

  gull(c,o,t,p){const v=V(p),n=p&&p.n||(2+Math.floor(R()*3)),k=rr(.85,1.15);let tt=t;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const d=i===0?.32:.2,f=1350*k*(1-i*.05),bp=filt(c,'bandpass',1700*k,2.5,o),g=env(c,bp,tt,.02,.5*v*(1-i*.15),d*.5,d*.6),s=osc(c,'sawtooth',f,tt,tt+d+.15,g);

 const LOOP={
   
  engine(c,o,p){const t=c.currentTime,lp=filt(c,'lowpass',500,1.1,o),sh=shaper(c,1.8,lp),g1=gn(c,0,sh),g2=gn(c,0,sh),a=osc(c,'sawtooth',30,t,0,g1),b=osc(c,'square',15,t,0,g2),j=lfo(c,5.3,.8,a.frequency,'sine',t);
   const nb=filt(c,'bandpass',300,1.4,o),ng=gn(c,0,nb),n=noise(c,'pink',t,0,ng),wg=gn(c,0,o),w=osc(c,'sine',600,t,0,wg);
   return{set(q,tt){const f=Math.max(8,q.f||30),th=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,q.th||0)),v=V(q),ev=!!q.ev;a.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f,tt,.07);b.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f*.5,tt,.07);lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(160+f*6+th*800,tt,.09);
     g1.gain.setTargetAtTime(ev?0:v*(.16+.14*th),tt,.08);g2.gain.setTargetAtTime(ev?0:v*.12,tt,.08);nb.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f*5,tt,.09);ng.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*(ev?.04:.05+.22*th),tt,.08);w.frequency.setTargetAtTime(ev?220+f*14:600,tt,.1);wg.gain.setTargetAtTime(ev?v*.09*(.3+th):0,tt,.1)},
    stop(tt){stopAll([a,b,j,n,w],tt)}}},
   
  car(c,o,p){const t=c.currentTime,lp=filt(c,'lowpass',300,.9,o),g=gn(c,0,lp),a=osc(c,'sawtooth',28,t,0,g),bp=filt(c,'bandpass',800,.7,o),tg=gn(c,0,bp),n=noise(c,'pink',t,0,tg);
   return{set(q,tt){const f=Math.max(10,q.f||28),v=V(q);a.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f,tt,.15);lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(140+f*5,tt,.15);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*.2,tt,.12);tg.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*(q.tire||0)*.6,tt,.12)},stop(tt){stopAll([a,n],tt)}}},
  horn(c,o,p){const t=c.currentTime,lp=filt(c,'lowpass',3200,.7,o),bp=filt(c,'bandpass',1500,.6,lp),g=gn(c,0,bp),a=osc(c,'square',(p&&p.low)?300:405,t,0,g),b=osc(c,'square',(p&&p.low)?378:507,t,0,g);
   return{set(q,tt){g.gain.setTargetAtTime(q.on?.16*V(q):0,tt,q.on?.004:.02)},stop(tt){stopAll([a,b],tt)}}},
  brake(c,o,p){const t=c.currentTime,g=gn(c,0,o),s=osc(c,'sine',2900,t,0,g),l=lfo(c,7,40,s.frequency,'sine',t),ng=gn(c,0,filt(c,'bandpass',1400,1,o)),n=noise(c,'pink',t,0,ng);
   return{set(q,tt){const v=V(q),sq=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,q.sq||0));g.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*.05*sq,tt,.05);ng.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*.25*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,q.scrub||0)),tt,.05)},stop(tt){stopAll([s,l,n],tt)}}},
   
  boat(c,o,p){const t=c.currentTime,lp=filt(c,'lowpass',500,1,o),am=gn(c,.6,lp),g=gn(c,0,am),a=osc(c,'sawtooth',40,t,0,g),tr=lfo(c,20,.35,am.gain,'square',t),wl=filt(c,'lowpass',700,.6,o),wg=gn(c,0,wl),n=noise(c,'pink',t,0,wg),sl=lfo(c,.6,0,wg.gain,'sine',t);
   return{set(q,tt){const s=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,q.s||0)),v=V(q),f=34+s*30;a.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f,tt,.12);tr.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f*.5,tt,.12);lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(300+s*900,tt,.12);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*(.14+.12*s),tt,.1);wg.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*(.05+.35*s),tt,.15);wl.frequency.setTargetAtTime(500+s*1300,tt,.15)},
    stop(tt){stopAll([a,tr,n,sl],tt)}}},
   
  reel(c,o,p){const t=c.currentTime,am=gn(c,0,filt(c,'bandpass',3600,4,o)),n=noise(c,'white',t,0,am),k=gn(c,0,am.gain),l=osc(c,'square',24,t,0,k);
   return{set(q,tt){const a=q.on?.11*V(q):0;l.frequency.setTargetAtTime(q.rate||24,tt,.05);am.gain.setTargetAtTime(a,tt,.02);k.gain.setTargetAtTime(a,tt,.02)},stop(tt){stopAll([n,l],tt)}}},

function rrect(g,x,y,w,h,r){r=Math.min(r,Math.abs(w)/2,Math.abs(h)/2);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x+r,y);g.lineTo(x+w-r,y);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);g.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);g.lineTo(x+r,y+h);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);g.lineTo(x,y+r);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);g.closePath()}
function polyPath(g,P){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(P[0][0],P[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)g.lineTo(P[i][0],P[i][1]);g.closePath()}
function hull(pts){const p=pts.slice().sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]||a[1]-b[1]),cr=(o,a,b)=>(a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1])-(a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0]),lo=[],up=[];
 for(const q of p){while(lo.length>=2&&cr(lo[lo.length-2],lo[lo.length-1],q)<=0)lo.pop();lo.push(q)}
 for(let i=p.length-1;i>=0;i--){const q=p[i];while(up.length>=2&&cr(up[up.length-2],up[up.length-1],q)<=0)up.pop();up.push(q)}return lo.slice(0,-1).concat(up.slice(0,-1))}

 return c}

 led(g,c+S-6.6,Y(30.9),5,2.6,5,null,o.sign!==false,det,night&&lit);g.restore();

  seg(15.8,21,'#b3221d','#ff4a3a');seg(12.4,15.5,'#d9822a','#ff9d3a');seg(10.3,12.1,'#e3e7ea','#ffffff');seg(7.2,10,'#9c1f1a','#ff3d30')}

function offsetTri(T,ex){const ar=(T[1][0]-T[0][0])*(T[2][1]-T[0][1])-(T[2][0]-T[0][0])*(T[1][1]-T[0][1]),sg=ar>0?1:-1,L=[];
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const a=T[i],b=T[(i+1)%3],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=sg*dy/l,ny=-sg*dx/l;L.push([a[0]+nx*ex,a[1]+ny*ex,dx,dy])}
 const out=[];for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const p=L[(i+2)%3],q=L[i],d=p[2]*q[3]-p[3]*q[2],v=T[i];let x,y;
  if(Math.abs(d)<1e-12){x=v[0];y=v[1]}else{const t=((q[0]-p[0])*q[3]-(q[1]-p[1])*q[2])/d;x=p[0]+p[2]*t;y=p[1]+p[3]*t}
  const mx=x-v[0],my=y-v[1],ml=Math.hypot(mx,my),lim=ex*14;if(ml>lim){x=v[0]+mx/ml*lim;y=v[1]+my/ml*lim}out.push([x,y])}return out}

function triTex(g,tex,D,t,s,ex,shade){const [a,b,c]=t,[A,B,C]=s,d=(b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(c[0]-a[0])*(b[1]-a[1]);if(Math.abs(d)<1e-9)return;
 const m11=((B[0]-A[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(C[0]-A[0])*(b[1]-a[1]))/d,m12=((C[0]-A[0])*(b[0]-a[0])-(B[0]-A[0])*(c[0]-a[0]))/d,m21=((B[1]-A[1])*(c[1]-a[1])-(C[1]-A[1])*(b[1]-a[1]))/d,m22=((C[1]-A[1])*(b[0]-a[0])-(B[1]-A[1])*(c[0]-a[0]))/d;
 const e=A[0]-m11*a[0]-m12*a[1],f=A[1]-m21*a[0]-m22*a[1];
 const O=offsetTri([A,B,C],ex);g.save();polyPath(g,O);g.clip();g.save();g.transform(m11,m21,m12,m22,e,f);g.drawImage(tex,0,0,tex.width/D,tex.height/D);g.restore();
 if(shade){g.fillStyle=shade;let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;for(const q of O){x0=Math.min(x0,q[0]);y0=Math.min(y0,q[1]);x1=Math.max(x1,q[0]);y1=Math.max(y1,q[1])}g.fillRect(x0-1,y0-1,x1-x0+2,y1-y0+2)}g.restore()}
function affine3(a,b,c,A,B,C){const d=(b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(c[0]-a[0])*(b[1]-a[1]);if(Math.abs(d)<1e-12)return null;
 const m11=((B[0]-A[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(C[0]-A[0])*(b[1]-a[1]))/d,m12=((C[0]-A[0])*(b[0]-a[0])-(B[0]-A[0])*(c[0]-a[0]))/d,m21=((B[1]-A[1])*(c[1]-a[1])-(C[1]-A[1])*(b[1]-a[1]))/d,m22=((C[1]-A[1])*(b[0]-a[0])-(B[1]-A[1])*(c[0]-a[0]))/d;
 return[m11,m21,m12,m22,A[0]-m11*a[0]-m12*a[1],A[1]-m21*a[0]-m22*a[1]]}
function shell(g,front,o,P,vis,dev,lowDetail,lk){const nc=lowDetail?2:dev<4?3:5,ns=1,C=outline(front,nc,ns),A=C[C.length-1].X,rows=front?(lowDetail?ROWS_F_LO:ROWS_F):(lowDetail?ROWS_R_LO:ROWS_R);
 const D=clamp(Math.ceil(dev*1.6),3,26),ser=D>=8?String(o.serial||'501'):'',key=(front?'F':'R')+'|'+D+'|'+(o.night?1:0)+(o.lit?1:0)+(o.sign===false?0:1)+'|'+ser,oo=Object.assign({},o,{serial:ser});
 const tex=texGet(key,()=>front?frontTex(oo,D,A):rearTex(oo,D,A)),ex=.55/dev,quads=[],NR=rows.length,NC=C.length,PT=[],NQ=[];
 for(let i=0;i<NC;i++){PT.push([]);for(let j=0;j<NR;j++)PT[i].push(shellPt(front,C[i],rows[j]))}
 for(let i=0;i<NC-1;i++){NQ.push([]);for(let j=0;j<NR-1;j++){const p00=PT[i][j],p10=PT[i+1][j],p01=PT[i][j+1],p11=PT[i+1][j+1];
  const e1=[p10[0]-p00[0]+p11[0]-p01[0],p10[1]-p00[1]+p11[1]-p01[1],p10[2]-p00[2]+p11[2]-p01[2]],e2=[p00[0]-p01[0]+p10[0]-p11[0],p00[1]-p01[1]+p10[1]-p11[1],p00[2]-p01[2]+p10[2]-p11[2]];
  let n=[e1[1]*e2[2]-e1[2]*e2[1],e1[2]*e2[0]-e1[0]*e2[2],e1[0]*e2[1]-e1[1]*e2[0]];const ln=Math.hypot(n[0],n[1],n[2]);if(ln<1e-6){NQ[i].push(null);continue}n=n.map(q=>q/ln);
  const mid=[(p00[0]+p11[0])/2,(p00[1]+p11[1])/2];if(n[0]*mid[0]+n[1]*mid[1]<0)n=n.map(q=>-q);NQ[i].push(n)}}
 
 const VB=[];for(let i=0;i<NC;i++){VB.push([]);for(let j=0;j<NR;j++){const a=[0,0,0];for(const [ii,jj] of [[i-1,j-1],[i,j-1],[i-1,j],[i,j]]){const n=NQ[ii]&&NQ[ii][jj];if(n){a[0]+=n[0];a[1]+=n[1];a[2]+=n[2]}}const l=Math.hypot(a[0],a[1],a[2]);VB[i].push(l>1e-6?lk(a.map(q=>q/l)):1)}}
 for(let i=0;i<NC-1;i++)for(let j=0;j<NR-1;j++){const n=NQ[i][j];if(!n||vis(n)<=.004)continue;const c0=C[i],c1=C[i+1],z0=rows[j],z1=rows[j+1];
  const zt0=Math.min(z0,zTop(c0.v)),zt1=Math.min(z1,zTop(c0.v)),zt0b=Math.min(z0,zTop(c1.v)),zt1b=Math.min(z1,zTop(c1.v));
  quads.push({T:[[c0.X,Hr-zt0],[c1.X,Hr-zt0b],[c0.X,Hr-zt1],[c1.X,Hr-zt1b]],S:[P(PT[i][j]),P(PT[i+1][j]),P(PT[i][j+1]),P(PT[i+1][j+1])],b:[VB[i][j],VB[i+1][j],VB[i][j+1],VB[i+1][j+1]]})}
 
 for(const q of quads){const [b00,b10,b01,b11]=q.b,S=q.S;let sh=null;
  if(Math.max(Math.abs(b00-1),Math.abs(b10-1),Math.abs(b01-1),Math.abs(b11-1))>=.005){const dv=Math.abs(b00+b10-b01-b11),dh=Math.abs(b00+b01-b10-b11),mid=(a,b)=>[(a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2];let A0,A1,c0,c1;
   if(dv>=dh){A0=mid(S[0],S[1]);A1=mid(S[2],S[3]);c0=(b00+b10)/2;c1=(b01+b11)/2}else{A0=mid(S[0],S[2]);A1=mid(S[1],S[3]);c0=(b00+b01)/2;c1=(b10+b11)/2}
   if(Math.hypot(A1[0]-A0[0],A1[1]-A0[1])<1e-6)sh=ovl((c0+c1)/2);else{sh=g.createLinearGradient(A0[0],A0[1],A1[0],A1[1]);sh.addColorStop(0,ovl(c0));sh.addColorStop(1,ovl(c1))}}
  triTex(g,tex,D,[q.T[0],q.T[1],q.T[3]],[S[0],S[1],S[3]],ex,sh);triTex(g,tex,D,[q.T[0],q.T[3],q.T[2]],[S[0],S[3],S[2]],ex,sh)}
 return quads.length}

 for(const u0 of [13.6,-47]){g.fillStyle='#d9dcdb';rrect(g,u0,-3.6,6.6,7.2,.6);g.fill();g.strokeStyle='rgba(90,98,104,.55)';g.lineWidth=.25;rrect(g,u0,-3.6,6.6,7.2,.6);g.stroke();g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.7)';g.fillRect(u0+.5,-3.2,5.6,.35)}

function roofEdges(g,o,P,vis,lk){   
 const n=3;for(const s of [-1,1])for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a0=Math.PI/2*i/n,a1=Math.PI/2*(i+1)/n,v0=s*((hw-Re)+Re*Math.sin(a0)),z0=zW+Re*Math.cos(a0),v1=s*((hw-Re)+Re*Math.sin(a1)),z1=zW+Re*Math.cos(a1);
  const am=(a0+a1)/2,nn=[0,s*Math.sin(am),Math.cos(am)];if(vis(nn)<=.004)continue;const b=lk(nn);
  const uf0=xF(v0,z0),uf1=xF(v1,z1),ur0=xR(v0,z0),ur1=xR(v1,z1),ucut=-49;
  g.fillStyle=litC(COL.white,b);polyPath(g,[P([ucut,v0,z0]),P([uf0,v0,z0]),P([uf1,v1,z1]),P([ucut,v1,z1])]);g.fill();
  g.fillStyle=litC(COL.red,b);polyPath(g,[P([ur0,v0,z0]),P([ucut+.05,v0,z0]),P([ucut+.05,v1,z1]),P([ur1,v1,z1])]);g.fill()}}
function prism(g,P,vis,base,z0,z1,col,topFn,lk){   
 const n=base.length;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=base[i],b=base[(i+1)%n],nn=[b[1]-a[1],-(b[0]-a[0]),0],l=Math.hypot(nn[0],nn[1])||1;nn[0]/=l;nn[1]/=l;if(vis(nn)<=.004)continue;
  g.fillStyle=litC(col,lk(nn));polyPath(g,[P([a[0],a[1],z0]),P([b[0],b[1],z0]),P([b[0],b[1],z1]),P([a[0],a[1],z1])]);g.fill()}
 g.fillStyle=col;polyPath(g,base.map(q=>P([q[0],q[1],z1])));g.fill();if(topFn)topFn()}
function acUnit(g,o,P,vis,M,det,lk){const {u0,u1,v}=AC,r=1.6,base=[];
 for(const [cu,cv,a0] of [[u1-r,-v+r,-Math.PI/2],[u1-r,v-r,0],[u0+r,v-r,Math.PI/2],[u0+r,-v+r,Math.PI]])for(let i=0;i<=3;i++){const a=a0+Math.PI/2*i/3;base.push([cu+r*Math.cos(a),cv+r*Math.sin(a)])}
 prism(g,P,vis,base,Hr,ACZ,'#e3e6e5',()=>{g.save();g.transform(M[0],M[1],M[2],M[3],M[4],M[5]-K*(ACZ-Hr));

function mirrorParts(s){

function rayHitsBody(p,Vb){let t0=0,t1=1e9;const lo=[-H2,-hw,0],hi=[H2,hw,Hr];for(let i=0;i<3;i++){if(Math.abs(Vb[i])<1e-9){if(p[i]<lo[i]||p[i]>hi[i])return false;continue}let a=(lo[i]-p[i])/Vb[i],b=(hi[i]-p[i])/Vb[i];if(a>b){const q=a;a=b;b=q}t0=Math.max(t0,a);t1=Math.min(t1,b);if(t0>t1)return false}return true}
function mirror(g,s,P,vis,o,lk){const M=mirrorParts(s),A=M.arm.map(P);g.lineCap='round';g.lineJoin='round';

function qSpec(id,vr){const B=Q[id],V=(B.variants&&vr&&B.variants[vr])||{};const S=Object.assign({},B,{col:Object.assign({},B.col)});
 for(const k in V){if(k in B.col)S.col[k]=V[k];else if(k==='patch'&&V.patch===false)S.patch=null;else if(k==='horns'&&typeof V.horns==='string')S.horns={t:V.horns,R:.14,A:1.2,b0:-.2,w:[.035,.012],sp:.0};else if(k==='chest'&&V.chest===false)S.noChest=true;else S[k]=V[k]}
 if(V.coat&&!V.light)S.col.light=sh(V.coat,1.25);return S}
 
const GAITS={walk:{off:{LH:0,LF:.25,RH:.5,RF:.75},duty:.64,lift:.09,bob:0},trot:{off:{LF:0,RH:0,RF:.5,LH:.5},duty:.46,lift:.16,bob:.02},run:{off:{LH:0,RH:.12,LF:.48,RF:.6},duty:.36,lift:.22,bob:.05}};
function foot(gait,stride,ph,id){const G=GAITS[gait];if(!G)return[0,0];const p=((ph+G.off[id])%1+1)%1;
 if(p<G.duty)return[stride*(.5-p/G.duty),0];const q=(p-G.duty)/(1-G.duty);return[stride*(-.5+q),G.lift*Math.sin(Math.PI*q)]}
function ik(H,F,a,b,fwd){const du=F[0]-H[0],dz=F[2]-H[2];let d=Math.hypot(du,dz);d=Math.max(Math.abs(a-b)+1e-3,Math.min(a+b-1e-3,d));const phi=Math.atan2(dz,du),al=Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(a*a+d*d-b*b)/(2*a*d)))),an=phi+(fwd?al:-al);
 return[H[0]+a*Math.cos(an),H[1],H[2]+a*Math.sin(an)]}
 
function quad(g,id,vr,pose,ph,h,o){const S=qSpec(id,vr),sc=S.scale||1,F=frame(h),C=S.col,near=F.near;o=o||{};
 const sz=p=>[p[0]*sc,p[1]*sc,p[2]*sc],sit=pose==='sit',lie=pose==='lie'||sit,gait=GAITS[pose]?pose:null,TP=ph*TAU;
 const bob=gait?Math.abs(Math.sin(TP*2))*GAITS[gait].bob:0,drop=lie?(S.body[3][1]-S.body[3][2]-.02):0;
 
 const SA=sit?(S.sitA||.8):0,R0=S.body[0],PV=[R0[0]*sc,0,(R0[1]-R0[2]-drop)*sc],rot=p=>sit?[PV[0]+(p[0]-PV[0])*Math.cos(SA)-(p[2]-PV[2])*Math.sin(SA),p[1],PV[2]+(p[0]-PV[0])*Math.sin(SA)+(p[2]-PV[2])*Math.cos(SA)]:p;
 
 const BS=[];{const R=S.body;for(let i=0;i<R.length-1;i++){const a=R[i],b=R[i+1],n=Math.max(1,Math.round((b[0]-a[0])/.07));for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const t=k/n,sm=t*t*(3-2*t),q=[lerp(a[0],b[0],t),lerp(a[1],b[1],sm),lerp(a[2],b[2],sm),lerp(a[3],b[3],sm)];BS.push({c:sz([q[0],0,q[1]-drop+bob]),d:[1,0,0],hh:q[2]*sc,hw:q[3]*sc})}}
  const z=R[R.length-1];BS.push({c:sz([z[0],0,z[1]-drop+bob]),d:[1,0,0],hh:z[2]*sc,hw:z[3]*sc});if(sit)for(const q of BS){q.c=rot(q.c);q.d=[Math.cos(SA),0,Math.sin(SA)]}}
 
 const legs=[];for(const [id2,L,side] of [['LF',S.fl,-1],['RF',S.fl,1],['LH',S.hl,-1],['RH',S.hl,1]]){const front=id2[1]==='F',H=sz([L.u,side*L.v,L.z-drop+bob]);let Fp,J,pts,ws;
  if(sit){const bw=S.body[3][3];if(front){const sh2=rot(H);Fp=[sh2[0]+.02*sc,side*L.v*sc,0];J=lerp3(sh2,Fp,.5);pts=[sh2,J,Fp];ws=L.w}else{J=sz([R0[0]+.08,side*bw*.95,.07]);Fp=sz([R0[0]+.2,side*bw*.75,.02]);pts=[J,Fp];ws=[L.w[0]*1.2,L.w[2]]}}
  else if(lie){const bw=S.body[3][3];if(front){J=sz([L.u+.12,side*(L.v+.02),.06]);Fp=sz([L.u-.04,side*L.v*.8,.04]);pts=[sz([L.u+.02,side*L.v,.2]),J,Fp]}
   else{J=sz([L.u-.06,side*(bw*.95),.07]);Fp=sz([L.u+.16,side*(bw*.98),.04]);pts=[J,Fp]}ws=front?[L.w[0]*.7,L.w[1],L.w[2]]:[L.w[1]*1.1,L.w[2]]}
  else{let fu=0,fz=0;if(gait){const f=foot(gait,(L.a+L.b)*({walk:.55,trot:.8,run:1.05}[gait]),ph,id2);fu=f[0];fz=f[1]*(L.a+L.b)/.9}else if(pose==='graze'||pose==='drink'){fu=front?.05:-.02}
   Fp=[H[0]+fu*sc,H[1],fz*sc];{const du=Fp[0]-H[0],dz=Fp[2]-H[2],d=Math.hypot(du,dz),mx=(L.a+L.b)*sc*.995;if(d>mx){Fp=[H[0]+du*mx/d,H[1],H[2]+dz*mx/d]}}
   J=ik(H,Fp,L.a*sc,L.b*sc,front);pts=[H,J,Fp];ws=L.w}
  legs.push({side,front,pts,ws:ws.map(w=>w*sc),key:F.D(sit?rot(H):H)+(side===near?.5:-.5)})}
 
 const N=S.neck,Hd=S.head;let up=N.up,pitch=Hd.pitch,look=o.look||0,jaw=0;
 if(pose==='graze'){up=N.graze+Math.sin(TP)*.05;pitch=Hd.gpitch;look=.12*Math.sin(TP+1)}else if(pose==='drink'){up=N.graze*.8;pitch=Hd.gpitch*.95}
 else if(sit){up=1.15;pitch=.15;look=.4*Math.sin(TP)}else if(lie){up=N.up*.7;pitch=Hd.pitch;jaw=Math.sin(TP*3)*.01}else if(gait==='walk'){up=N.up-.06+Math.sin(TP*2)*.04}else if(gait==='run'){up=N.up*.55}else if(pose==='stand'){look=(o.look!=null?o.look:.25*Math.sin(TP));pitch=Hd.spitch!=null?Hd.spitch:pitch}
 const nb=rot(sz([N.u,0,N.z-drop+bob])),nd=[Math.cos(up)*Math.cos(look),Math.cos(up)*Math.sin(look),Math.sin(up)],ne=add(nb,mul(nd,N.len*sc));
 const NS=[];for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){const t=i/4;NS.push({c:lerp3(nb,ne,t),d:nd,hh:lerp(N.r0,N.r1,t)*sc,hw:lerp(N.r0,N.r1,t)*sc*.85})}
 
 const hdv=[Math.cos(pitch)*Math.cos(look),Math.cos(pitch)*Math.sin(look),-Math.sin(pitch)],h0=add(ne,mul(hdv,-.02*sc)),h1=add(h0,mul(hdv,Hd.len*sc));
 const HS=[];for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){const t=i/5,r0=Hd.r0,r1=Hd.r1;HS.push({c:add(lerp3(h0,h1,t),[0,0,(i>=4?jaw:0)]),d:hdv,hh:lerp(r0[0],r1[0],t*t)*sc,hw:lerp(r0[1],r1[1],t)*sc})}
 let hl=crs([0,0,1],hdv);hl=nrm(Math.hypot(...hl)<1e-6?[0,1,0]:hl);const hn=nrm(crs(hdv,hl));   
 
 const T=S.tail,tb=sit?add(PV,[.01*sc,0,.03*sc]):sz([T.u,0,T.z-drop+bob]),TL=[];if(sit){const bw=S.body[3][3];for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){const t=i/5;TL.push(add(tb,mul([.02+.26*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*.85),near*(bw+.03)*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*.6)+near*.02,.0],sc)))}}else{const sw=lie?.15*Math.sin(TP):pose==='stand'||pose==='graze'?.35*Math.sin(TP*2):gait==='run'?.1:.18*Math.sin(TP*2);
  for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){const t=i/5;let p;if(T.up)p=[-t*T.len*.5,sw*.3*t*T.len,t*T.len*.85];else if(T.hair)p=[-t*T.len*.45,sw*t*T.len*.4,-t*T.len*.9+(gait==='run'?t*T.len*.5:0)];
   else p=[-t*T.len*(gait==='run'?.6:.25),sw*t*T.len*.5,-t*T.len*(gait==='run'?.5:.95)];if(T.curl)p=[-t*T.len*.6,sw*.2*t,t*t*T.len*.7];TL.push(add(tb,mul(p,sc)))}}
 
 groundEll(g,F,0,0,S.L*.48*sc*(lie?1.05:1),(S.body[3][3]*1.35+.04)*sc,'#000000',.2);
 
 const parts=[];const Dbody=F.D(BS[BS.length>>1].c);
 for(const L of legs)parts.push({k:L.key+(L.side===near?2:-2),f:()=>{if(lie&&L.side!==near&&!(sit&&L.front))return;limb(g,F,L.pts,L.ws,L.side===near?C.leg:sh(C.leg,.68));
   if(S.col.legStripe&&!lie)line(g,F,[lerp3(L.pts[1],L.pts[2],.1),lerp3(L.pts[1],L.pts[2],.85)],L.ws[1]*.45,L.side===near?C.legStripe:sh(C.legStripe,.7));
   if(!lie||(sit&&L.front)){const f=F.P(L.pts[L.pts.length-1]);g.fillStyle=C.hoof;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(f[0],f[1]-.2,Math.max(.4,L.ws[2]*M*.62),Math.max(.3,L.ws[2]*M*.42),0,0,TAU);g.fill()}}});
 parts.push({k:F.D(tb)+(F.s<0?.3:-.3),f:()=>{if(T.fat){tube(g,F,[{c:add(tb,[0,0,-T.len*.3*sc]),d:[0,0,1],hh:T.len*.45*sc,hw:T.w*sc},{c:add(tb,[-.04*sc,0,-T.len*.75*sc]),d:[0,0,1],hh:T.len*.25*sc,hw:T.w*.85*sc}],C.shade);
   tube(g,F,[{c:add(tb,[0,0,-T.len*.3*sc]),d:[0,0,1],hh:T.len*.42*sc,hw:T.w*.92*sc},{c:add(tb,[-.04*sc,0,-T.len*.72*sc]),d:[0,0,1],hh:T.len*.22*sc,hw:T.w*.78*sc}],C.coat);return}
  limb(g,F,TL,TL.map((_,i)=>T.w*sc*(1-i/7)*(T.hair?1.2:1)),T.hair?C.mane:sh(C.coat,.9));if(T.tuft)limb(g,F,[TL[TL.length-2],TL[TL.length-1]],[T.tuft[0]*sc*.6,T.tuft[0]*sc*1.6],C.tuft);
  if(id==='gazelle'||id==='ibex')line(g,F,TL.slice(2),T.w*sc*.8,'#1e1610')}});
 if(S.udder&&!lie)parts.push({k:Dbody-.05,f:()=>{const p=sz([S.udder.u,0,S.udder.z]);dot(g,F,p,S.udder.r*sc,C.udder);for(const s of[-1,1])dot(g,F,add(p,[.03*s*sc,s*.04*sc,-.1*sc]),.022*sc,sh(C.udder,.82))}});
 parts.push({k:Dbody,f:()=>{
  tube(g,F,BS,C.shade,{kw:1.05,kh:1.06,dn:-.02});tube(g,F,BS,C.coat);
  if(!S.noChest&&C.chest)tube(g,F,BS.filter(q=>q.c[0]>.15*sc),C.chest,{kw:.96,kh:.62,dn:-.38,a:.85});
  if(id==='gazelle'){tube(g,F,BS,C.belly,{kw:.92,kh:.42,dn:-.62});tube(g,F,BS.slice(0,2),C.rump,{kw:.9,kh:.85,dn:.05})}
  else tube(g,F,BS,C.belly,{kw:.85,kh:.45,dn:-.6,a:.8});
  tube(g,F,BS,C.light,{kw:.6,kh:.45,dn:.5,a:.75});
  if(S.patch)blobs(g,F,BS,S.patch,S.patchCol,sc);
  if(C.tabby){for(let i=1;i<BS.length-1;i+=2)tube(g,F,[BS[i]],C.tabby,{kw:.92,kh:.5,dn:.45,a:.55})}

function bSpec(id,vr){const S0=B[id],V=(S0.variants&&vr&&S0.variants[vr])||{};const S=Object.assign({},S0,{col:Object.assign({},S0.col)});for(const k in V){if(k in S0.col)S.col[k]=V[k];else S[k]=V[k]}return S}


function bird(g,id,vr,pose,ph,h,o){const S=bSpec(id,vr),sc=S.scale||1,F=frame(h),C=S.col,near=F.near,TP=ph*TAU;o=o||{};
 const fly=pose==='fly'||pose==='glide'||pose==='takeoff',swim=pose==='swim'||pose==='dabble',sit=pose==='sit',L=S.len*sc,hh=S.r[0]*sc,hw=S.r[1]*sc;
 let zc=fly?0:swim?hh*.45:sit?hh*.95:S.zc*sc,tilt=fly?0:swim?.0:sit?.05:S.tilt;let bob=0,headD=0,headZ=0;
 if(pose==='walk'){bob=Math.abs(Math.sin(TP*2))*.006*sc;headD=(id==='pigeon'||id==='chicken'?Math.sin(TP*2)*.025:0)*sc}

 if(!fly&&!swim&&!sit){for(const s of[-1,1]){const hip=add(bc,[0,s*hw*.4,-hh*.6]);let fu=0,fz=0;if(pose==='walk'){const q=((ph+(s>0?.5:0))%1);fu=(q<.5?(.5-q*2):(-.5+(q-.5)*2))*.06*sc;fz=q>=.5?Math.sin((q-.5)*2*Math.PI)*.015*sc:0}
   const ft=[hip[0]+fu,hip[1],fz];parts.push({k:F.D(hip)+(s===near?3:-3),f:()=>{line(g,F,[hip,ft],Math.max(.008,S.legs*.12)*sc,s===near?C.leg:sh(C.leg,.7));

    poly(g,F,[lerp3(r,tip,.7),tip,add(lerp3(r,tip,.8),down)],C.tip,.9)}})}}

  if(S.rooster){for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const b0=add(tb,[0,(k-1.5)*.02*sc,.02*sc]);line(g,F,[b0,add(b0,[-.08*sc,(k-1.5)*.02*sc,.14*sc]),add(b0,[-.2*sc,(k-1.5)*.03*sc,.1*sc]),add(b0,[-.24*sc,(k-1.5)*.03*sc,.02*sc])],.016*sc,k%2?C.tail:C.tailTip)}}}});
 
 parts.push({k:Dbody,f:()=>{tube(g,F,BS,sh(C.body,.62),{kw:1.06,kh:1.06});tube(g,F,BS,C.body);tube(g,F,BS,C.belly,{kw:.85,kh:.45,dn:-.55,a:.85});

function turtle(g,id,vr,pose,ph,h,o){const S=T[id],F=frame(h),C=S.col,near=F.near,TP=ph*TAU,swim=pose==='swim',rest=pose==='rest';

   root=[fu,sd*fv,.06+low],dir=[-.35-.55*st,sd*(.85-.25*Math.abs(st)),swim?.1*Math.cos(TP):-.08],d=nrm(dir),tip=add(root,mul(d,fl)),mid=add(lerp3(root,tip,.5),[.0,0,.0]),w=[-d[1]*fw*sd*.0,0,0];
   const P1=add(root,[.05,0,0]),P2=add(mid,[.04,sd*.0,0]),P3=tip,P4=add(mid,[-.06,0,0]),P5=add(root,[-.06,0,0]);
   parts.push({k:F.D(root)+(sd===near?1:-1),f:()=>{poly(g,F,[P1,P2,P3,P4,P5],sd===near?C.skin:sh(C.skin,.72));for(let k=1;k<4;k++)dot(g,F,lerp3(root,tip,k/4),.012,C.scale||sh(C.skin,1.3),.6)}});
   const rr=[ru,sd*rv,.05+low],rt=add(rr,[-rl*.8,sd*rl*.5,-.03]);parts.push({k:F.D(rr)+(sd===near?1:-1),f:()=>poly(g,F,[add(rr,[.04,0,0]),rt,add(rr,[-.05,sd*.02,0])],sd===near?C.skin:sh(C.skin,.72))})}}

   const hip=[lu,sd*lv*.85,.04],ft=[lu+step+(front?.02:-.02),sd*(lv+.02),lift],pts=rest?[hip,add(hip,[front?.02:-.02,sd*.02,-.03])]:[hip,lerp3(hip,ft,.5),ft];
   parts.push({k:F.D(hip)+(sd===near?1:-1),f:()=>{limb(g,F,pts,pts.map(()=>lw),sd===near?C.skin:sh(C.skin,.72));if(!rest){const f=F.P(ft);g.fillStyle=C.dark;g.beginPath();g.ellipse(f[0],f[1],Math.max(.3,lw*M*.55),Math.max(.25,lw*M*.35),0,0,TAU);g.fill()}}})}}
 
 {const [hu,hz,hl2,hr]=S.head,out=rest&&!S.sea?.35:1,look=pose==='walk'||pose==='crawl'?.18*Math.sin(TP*.5):.3*Math.sin(TP),dirH=[Math.cos(look),Math.sin(look),swim?.05:-.12],b0=[hu-.03,0,hz+low],b1=add(b0,mul(dirH,hl2*out));

const CACHE=new Map();

function isBird(id){return!!B[id]}
function isTurtle(id){return!!T[id]}
function nFrames(id,pose){if(isTurtle(id))return pose==='rest'?4:8;return isBird(id)?(FR[pose==='stand'||pose==='walk'?'b'+pose:pose]||4):(FR[pose]||8)}
function resOf(g){try{const T=g.getTransform();const k=Math.hypot(T.a,T.b)||1;const L=[1,1.5,2,3,4.5,6];for(const r of L)if(k<=r*1.08)return r;return 6}catch(e){return 1}}

function boxOf(id,vr,pose,h){const S=isTurtle(id)?T[id]:isBird(id)?bSpec(id,vr):qSpec(id,vr),sc=S.scale||1,b=S.box,fly=pose==='fly'||pose==='glide'||pose==='takeoff',F=frame(h);
 const Rb=(fly?b[0]+.3:b[0])*sc,Rf=b[1]*sc,W=(fly?Math.max(b[2],(S.span||0)*.55):b[2])*sc,z0=fly?-(S.span||1)*.45*sc:-.05,z1=(fly?(S.span||1)*.45:b[3])*sc;let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;
 for(const u of[-Rb,Rf])for(const v of[-W,W])for(const z of[z0,z1]){const p=F.P([u,v,z]);x0=Math.min(x0,p[0]);x1=Math.max(x1,p[0]);y0=Math.min(y0,p[1]);y1=Math.max(y1,p[1])}
 return[Math.floor(x0-2),Math.floor(y0-2),Math.ceil(x1+2),Math.ceil(y1+2)]}

let mkCanvas=(w,h)=>{const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;return c};
function make(key,id,vr,pose,fi,nf,di,nd,r,o){const t0=performance.now(),h=di*TAU/nd,bx=boxOf(id,vr,pose,h),w=bx[2]-bx[0],hh=bx[3]-bx[1],cv=mkCanvas(Math.max(1,Math.ceil(w*r)),Math.max(1,Math.ceil(hh*r))),g=cv.getContext('2d');

 CACHE.set(key,e);ST.bytes+=e.bytes;ST.made++;const dt=performance.now()-t0;ST.madeMs+=dt;ST.frameMs+=dt;
 if(ST.bytes>ST.budgetMB*1048576){let n=Math.ceil(CACHE.size/4);for(const [k,v] of CACHE){if(k===key)continue;CACHE.delete(k);ST.bytes-=v.bytes;ST.evict++;if(--n<=0)break}}
 return e}
function tick(){const f=(typeof performance!=='undefined'?Math.floor(performance.now()/16):0);if(f!==ST.frameAt){ST.frameAt=f;ST.frameMs=0}}

  key=id+'|'+(vr||'')+'|'+pose+'|'+fi+'|'+di+'|'+r+(o.key?'|'+o.key:''),alt=o.alt||0;tick();
  if(alt>0&&!o.noShadow){const sa=Math.max(.04,.2-alt*.008),s=isBird(id)?bSpec(id,vr):null,sp=(s?(pose==='fly'||pose==='glide'?s.span*.38:s.len*.4):.4)*(s&&s.scale||1);g.globalAlpha=sa;g.fillStyle='#000';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x+alt*.35,y+alt*.25,sp*M,sp*M*KY*.6,0,0,TAU);g.fill();g.globalAlpha=1}

  if(e){ST.hits++;if(o.alpha!=null)g.globalAlpha=o.alpha;g.drawImage(e.cv,x-e.ox,yy-e.oy,e.w,e.h);if(o.alpha!=null)g.globalAlpha=1;return 1}
  ST.direct++;g.save();g.translate(x,yy);if(o.alpha!=null)g.globalAlpha=o.alpha;paint(g,id,vr,pose,fi/nf,di*TAU/nd,o);g.restore();return 2}
 catch(err){ST.err=ST.err||String(err&&err.stack||err).slice(0,300);ST.lastErr=String(err&&err.message||err);return 0}}

const SCR=new Map();
function script(H,mi){const key=H.id+(mi!=null?'#'+mi:'');let s=SCR.get(key);if(s)return s;const segs=[];let T=0;const sp=mi!=null?H.m[mi][3]:H.spots,n=sp.length;
 for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const a=sp[k],b=sp[(k+1)%n],d=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),dur=d/(H.v*M),h=Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0]);
  segs.push({t0:T,t1:T+a[2],stay:true,x:a[0],y:a[1],h:a[3]!=null?a[3]:h,pose:a[4]});T+=a[2];segs.push({t0:T,t1:T+dur,stay:false,a,b,h,d});T+=dur}
 s={segs,P:T};SCR.set(key,s);return s}
function centre(H,t,mi){const S=script(H,mi),u=((t%S.P)+S.P)%S.P;for(const g of S.segs)if(u<g.t1){if(g.stay)return{x:g.x,y:g.y,mv:false,h:g.h,d:0,u:u-g.t0,pose:g.pose};const f=(u-g.t0)/(g.t1-g.t0);return{x:g.a[0]+(g.b[0]-g.a[0])*f,y:g.a[1]+(g.b[1]-g.a[1])*f,mv:true,h:g.h,d:f*g.d/M,u:u-g.t0}}
 const g=S.segs[0];return{x:g.x,y:g.y,mv:false,h:g.h,d:0,u:0}}
 
function target(H,i,t,night){const m=H.m[i];
 if(night&&!H.day&&H.night){const q=H.night[i%H.night.length],bd=AN34.isBird(spOf(H,i));return{x:q[0],y:q[1],h:q[2]+(bd?.7:.15)*Math.sin(t*(bd?.09:.05)+i*1.7),mv:false,rest:true,perch:q[3]||0,npose:q[4]||null}}

const FOL=new Map();
function follow(H,i,T,now,live){if(!live)return T;const k=H.id+i;let f=FOL.get(k);const v=H.v*M*1.3;
 if(!f||now-f.t>700||Math.hypot(T.x-f.x,T.y-f.y)>400){FOL.set(k,{x:T.x,y:T.y,t:now,dist:0});return T}

function spOf(H,i){return H.m[i][4]||(H.m[i][0]==='goat'?'goat':H.sp)}
function poseOf(H,i,T,t){const sp=spOf(H,i),ph0=hsh(i*3+H.id.length);

 if(T.rest){if(T.npose)return{sp,pose:T.npose,ph:(t*.15+ph0)%1};if(AN34.isBird(sp)){if(T.perch)return{sp,pose:'sit',ph:0};return{sp,pose:'sit',ph:0}}return{sp,pose:'lie',ph:(t*.22+ph0)%1}}

  if(H.swim)return{sp,pose:'swim',ph:(t*.8+ph0)%1};return{sp,pose:'walk',ph:((d/stride)+ph0)%1}}

  if(T.pose==='sit')return{sp,pose:'sit',ph:(t*.2+ph0)%1};if(T.pose==='lie')return{sp,pose:'lie',ph:(t*.18+ph0)%1};return{sp,pose:sp==='cat'?'stand':(u<13?'stand':'graze'),ph:(t*.3+ph0)%1}}

function vegWalls(x0,y0,x1,y1,S){const W=VEG.W;if(!W||!W.length)return;const K=.6*10,g=ctx;g.save();g.lineJoin='round';
 try{for(const w of W){const ax=w[0],ay=w[1],bx=w[2],by=w[3];if(Math.max(ax,bx)<x0-40||Math.min(ax,bx)>x1+40||Math.max(ay,by)<y0-40||Math.min(ay,by)>y1+40)continue;
  const h=w[4]/10,kind=w[5],side=w[6]?1:-1,L=Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay);if(L<1)continue;const ux=(bx-ax)/L,uy=(by-ay)/L,nx=-uy*side,ny=ux*side,H=h*K;   
  if(kind===1){vegStairs(g,ax,ay,bx,by,ux,uy,nx,ny,h);continue}
  const T=4.2,tx=-nx*T,ty=-ny*T;   
  if(ny>.3){   
   g.fillStyle='#9b927f';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx,by-H);g.lineTo(ax,ay-H);g.closePath();g.fill();
   g.strokeStyle='rgba(60,50,38,.35)';g.lineWidth=.6;g.beginPath();for(let z=2.2;z<H-.5;z+=2.4){g.moveTo(ax,ay-z);g.lineTo(bx,by-z)}for(let s=0,k=0;s<L;s+=5,k++){const px=ax+ux*s,py=ay+uy*s;for(let z=0;z<H;z+=2.4){const o=(Math.floor(z/2.4)%2)*2.5;g.moveTo(px+ux*o,py+uy*o-z);g.lineTo(px+ux*o,py+uy*o-Math.min(H,z+2.4))}}g.stroke();
   g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.18)';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx+nx*2.5,by+ny*2.5);g.lineTo(ax+nx*2.5,ay+ny*2.5);g.closePath();g.fill()}
  else{   
   const d=Math.max(4,H*1.2),st=3.6;g.fillStyle='rgba(28,24,18,.42)';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax+nx*st,ay+ny*st);g.lineTo(bx+nx*st,by+ny*st);g.lineTo(bx+nx*(st+d),by+ny*(st+d));g.lineTo(ax+nx*(st+d),ay+ny*(st+d));g.closePath();g.fill();
   g.fillStyle='#8f8673';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx+nx*st,by+ny*st);g.lineTo(ax+nx*st,ay+ny*st);g.closePath();g.fill();
   g.strokeStyle='rgba(55,46,34,.5)';g.lineWidth=.6;g.beginPath();for(let s=2.5;s<L;s+=5){const px=ax+ux*s,py=ay+uy*s;g.moveTo(px,py);g.lineTo(px+nx*st,py+ny*st)}g.stroke()}
  const ty2=ny>.3?-H:0;g.fillStyle='#e2d9c4';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay+ty2);g.lineTo(bx,by+ty2);g.lineTo(bx+tx,by+ty+ty2);g.lineTo(ax+tx,ay+ty+ty2);g.closePath();g.fill();
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(70,60,45,.6)';g.lineWidth=.7;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay+ty2);g.lineTo(bx,by+ty2);g.moveTo(ax+tx,ay+ty+ty2);g.lineTo(bx+tx,by+ty+ty2);g.stroke();VEG.n.wallsDrawn++}}
 catch(e){vegErr(e)}finally{g.restore()}}

function vegStairs(g,ax,ay,bx,by,ux,uy,nx,ny,h){const K=6,n=Math.max(3,Math.min(8,Math.round(h/.16))),run=2.6,Hs=h*K/n,face=ny>.3;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const o=i*run,z=(i+1)*Hs*(face?1:0),p0x=ax-nx*o,p0y=ay-ny*o,p1x=bx-nx*o,p1y=by-ny*o;
  if(face){g.fillStyle='#a8a08c';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(p0x,p0y-z+Hs);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y-z+Hs);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y-z);g.lineTo(p0x,p0y-z);g.closePath();g.fill()}
  if(!face){g.strokeStyle='rgba(60,52,40,.7)';g.lineWidth=.8;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(p0x,p0y);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y);g.stroke()}
  g.fillStyle=i%2?'#d8d0bd':'#e9e1cf';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(p0x,p0y-z);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y-z);g.lineTo(p1x-nx*run,p1y-ny*run-z);g.lineTo(p0x-nx*run,p0y-ny*run-z);g.closePath();g.fill()}
 const e=run*n;g.strokeStyle='#6f6a60';g.lineWidth=.7;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(ax-nx*e,ay-ny*e-(face?h*K:0));g.moveTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx-nx*e,by-ny*e-(face?h*K:0));g.stroke()}

function tmnlLoopBuild(c){const r=c.r,cx=c.cx,y0=c.y0,y1=c.y1,P=[[cx+r,y0],[cx+r,y1]];const n=12;

 const cuLen=[0];for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)cuLen.push(cuLen[i-1]+Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]));return{P,cuLen,L:cuLen[cuLen.length-1]}}
function tmnlAlongC(P,cuLen,s){const L=cuLen[cuLen.length-1];s=((s%L)+L)%L;let lo=0,hi=cuLen.length-1;while(lo<hi-1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(cuLen[m]<=s)lo=m;else hi=m}const a=P[lo],b=P[hi],l=cuLen[hi]-cuLen[lo]||1,f=(s-cuLen[lo])/l;return[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*f,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*f,Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0])]}

    for (const s of [1, -1]) P.push(box(-.36, .3, s > 0 ? .2 : -.42, s > 0 ? .42 : -.2, .36, .42, { col: dk, mat: MAT.rubber, under: 1 }));   
    for (const [u0, u1, z] of [[.42, .86, .86], [-.96, -.5, .86]]) { for (const s of [1, -1]) P.push(tube([[u0, s * .4, z], [u1, s * .4, z]], .014, { col: C.black, mat: MAT.metal })); for (const u of [u0, (u0 + u1) / 2, u1]) P.push(tube([[u, -.4, z], [u, .4, z]], .012, { col: C.black, mat: MAT.metal })) }   
    P.push(tube([[.34, 0, .9], [.36, 0, 1.03]], .025, { col: C.black, mat: MAT.metal }), tube([[.33, -.42, 1.06], [.37, 0, 1.04], [.33, .42, 1.06]], .014, { col: C.black, mat: MAT.metal, bar: 1 }), prism([[.3, 1.0, .1], [.33, 1.1, .1], [.44, 1.08, .09], [.44, 1.0, .09]], { col: pc, mat: MAT.paint, bar: 1 }));
    for (const s of [1, -1]) P.push(tube([[.33, s * .34, 1.06], [.32, s * .43, 1.06]], .02, { col: C.rubber, mat: MAT.rubber, bar: 1 }), disc([1.0, s * .2, .64], [1, 0, .1], .055, { col: C.lampW, mat: MAT.lamp, ring: C.dark }), disc([-1.0, s * .26, .64], [-1, 0, 0], .035, { col: C.lampR, mat: MAT.lamp, ring: C.dark }));
    P.push(box(1.0, 1.08, -.36, .36, .36, .46, { col: C.black, mat: MAT.metal }));   
    return P },
  rider: { u: -.2, ride: { seat: .94, lean: .2, pitch: -.06, peg: [.18, .27, .42], bar: [.54, .38, 1.06], knee: .45 } },
  lamps: [['H', 1.0, .2, .64, [1, 0, .1]], ['H', 1.0, -.2, .64, [1, 0, .1]], ['T', -1.0, .26, .64, [-1, 0, 0]], ['T', -1.0, -.26, .64, [-1, 0, 0]]] };


const SK = ['#d9a57f', '#c99a74', '#b9835a', '#e0b48e', '#a8714c', '#8a5a3a'];
function look(role, i) { i = i | 0; const sk = SK[i % SK.length], pick = (a) => a[i % a.length];
  const base = { h: 1.74 + (i % 5) * .025, skin: sk, hair: { t: 'none', c: '#2b2018' }, shoes: { t: 'sneaker', c: '#2d3440' } };
  if (role === 'BK') return Object.assign(base, { hair: { t: 'short', c: pick(['#3b2a1f', '#1c1a18', '#6b4a2a', '#2a2420']) }, top: { t: 'tee', c: pick(['#2f6fd0', '#e8462f', '#2e8b57', '#f2c230', '#f4f6f8', '#7a4ccf']) }, legs: { t: pick(['shorts', 'trousers', 'shorts']), c: pick(['#27455f', '#3d4450', '#2b2f36']) }, shoes: { t: 'sneaker', c: pick(['#e9ecef', '#2d3440']) }, hat: { t: 'bikeh', c: pick(['#e8462f', '#f4f6f8', '#1f5aa6', '#22262b', '#f2c230']) } });
  if (role === 'SC') return Object.assign(base, { top: { t: 'jacket', c: pick(['#2b3a48', '#5b3a29', '#3d4450', '#1f5aa6', '#6b737b']) }, legs: { t: 'jeans', c: '#2d3a4f' }, hat: { t: 'jet', c: pick(['#f4f6f8', '#22262b', '#c8262b', '#1f5aa6', '#b9c0c7']) } });
  if (role === 'MC') return Object.assign(base, { top: { t: 'jacket', c: pick(['#1c1e22', '#3a2a20', '#22262b', '#5d1f1f']) }, legs: { t: 'jeans', c: '#22303f' }, shoes: { t: 'boot', c: '#1c1a18' }, hat: { t: 'moto', c: pick(['#22262b', '#f4f6f8', '#c8262b', '#1f5aa6']), s: pick([null, '#f2c230', null, '#f4f6f8']) } });
  if (role === 'PM') return Object.assign(base, { top: { t: 'jacket', c: '#1b2b45' }, legs: { t: 'trousers', c: '#1b2b45' }, shoes: { t: 'boot', c: '#141414' }, vest: '#d8e21a', badge: { k: 'star', c: '#c3c9cf', c2: '#1b2b45' }, hat: { t: 'moto', c: '#f4f6f8', s: '#1f4fa8', open: 1 } });
  if (role === 'CR') return Object.assign(base, { top: { t: 'jacket', c: '#ee7d2d' }, legs: { t: 'trousers', c: '#2b2f36' }, shoes: { t: 'sneaker', c: '#2d3440' }, hat: { t: 'jet', c: '#22262b', s: '#ee7d2d' } });
  if (role === 'JP') return Object.assign(base, { hair: { t: 'short', c: pick(['#3b2a1f', '#1c1a18', '#8a8a86']) }, top: { t: pick(['polo', 'tee', 'shirt']), c: pick(['#f4f6f8', '#3d7a3a', '#c9a46a', '#1f5aa6']) }, legs: { t: 'trousers', c: '#4a4f55' }, hat: i % 2 ? { t: 'cap', c: pick(['#2f6b45', '#c8262b', '#22262b']) } : null, glasses: '#1b1d20' });
  if (role === 'AT') return Object.assign(base, { top: { t: 'jacket', c: pick(['#3d5a2a', '#c8262b', '#2b3a48', '#e8462f']) }, legs: { t: 'trousers', c: '#3a3f45' }, shoes: { t: 'boot', c: '#2a211b' }, hat: { t: 'moto', c: pick(['#f2c230', '#22262b', '#f4f6f8', '#e8462f']), s: '#22262b' } });
  return base }



function frame(h, ox, oy) { const cs = Math.cos(h), sn = Math.sin(h);
  const W = p => [ox + p[0] * cs + p[1] * sn, oy + p[0] * sn - p[1] * cs, p[2]];   
  const Pj = w => [w[0] * SCALE, (w[1] - K * w[2]) * SCALE], WN = n => [n[0] * cs + n[1] * sn, n[0] * sn - n[1] * cs, n[2]];
  return { cs, sn, W, Pj, P: p => Pj(W(p)), WN, y: p => W(p)[1] } }
function shadeFill(c, pts, hexc, n, mat, F, alpha) { c.beginPath(); poly(c, pts); const b = bri(nrm(F.WN(n)), mat); c.fillStyle = col(hexc, b); if (alpha != null) { const a0 = c.globalAlpha; c.globalAlpha = a0 * alpha; c.fill(); c.globalAlpha = a0 } else c.fill() }

function prismPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const v0 = s.v || 0, Q = s.pts, n = Q.length, A = Q.map(q => [q[0], v0 + q[2], q[1]]), B = Q.map(q => [q[0], v0 - q[2], q[1]]);
  const PA = A.map(F.P), PB = B.map(F.P), faces = [];
  
  const ccw = area2(Q.map(q => [q[0], q[1]])) > 0;
  faces.push({ q: PA, n: [0, 1, 0] }, { q: PB, n: [0, -1, 0] });
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n, e = [Q[j][0] - Q[i][0], 0, Q[j][1] - Q[i][1]], nn = nrm(ccw ? [e[2], 0, -e[0]] : [-e[2], 0, e[0]]);   
    faces.push({ q: [PA[i], PA[j], PB[j], PB[i]], n: nn, strip: 1 }) }
  const vis = faces.filter(f => facesCam(f.n, F));
  const cy = F.y([Q.reduce((a, q) => a + q[0], 0) / n, v0, Q.reduce((a, q) => a + q[1], 0) / n]);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: PA.concat(PB), paint: c => { for (const f of vis) shadeFill(c, f.q, s.col, f.n, s.mat, F, s.alpha);
      if (s.stripe && lod < 2) { const [sc, z0, z1] = s.stripe; for (const f of vis) { if (f.strip) continue; c.save(); c.beginPath(); poly(c, f.q); c.clip();
          const u0 = Math.min(...Q.map(q => q[0])) - .05, u1 = Math.max(...Q.map(q => q[0])) + .05, vv = f.n[1] > 0 ? v0 + Math.max(...Q.map(q => q[2])) : v0 - Math.max(...Q.map(q => q[2]));
          poly(c, [F.P([u0, vv, z0]), F.P([u1, vv, z0]), F.P([u1, vv, z1]), F.P([u0, vv, z1])]); c.fillStyle = col(sc, bri(nrm(F.WN(f.n)), MAT.paint)); c.fill(); c.restore() } }
      if (s.grille && lod < 2) { const u = Q[Q.length - 2][0] + .005; for (let k = -3; k <= 3; k++) { const vv = v0 + k * .1; c.beginPath(); const a = F.P([u, vv, .66]), b = F.P([u, vv, .98]); c.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); c.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); c.lineWidth = .035 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,12,14,.55)'; c.stroke() } }
      c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineWidth = .006 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,10,13,.28)'; for (const f of vis) { c.beginPath(); poly(c, f.q); c.stroke() } } }) }

function facesCam(n, F) { const w = nrm(F.WN(n)); return w[1] * K + w[2] > 1e-3 }
function boxPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const P = [], q = (u, v, z) => F.P([u, v, z]), { u0, u1, v0, v1, z0, z1 } = s, faces = [
    { q: [q(u1, v0, z0), q(u1, v1, z0), q(u1, v1, z1), q(u1, v0, z1)], n: [1, 0, 0] }, { q: [q(u0, v1, z0), q(u0, v0, z0), q(u0, v0, z1), q(u0, v1, z1)], n: [-1, 0, 0] },
    { q: [q(u1, v1, z0), q(u0, v1, z0), q(u0, v1, z1), q(u1, v1, z1)], n: [0, 1, 0] }, { q: [q(u0, v0, z0), q(u1, v0, z0), q(u1, v0, z1), q(u0, v0, z1)], n: [0, -1, 0] },
    { q: [q(u0, v0, z1), q(u1, v0, z1), q(u1, v1, z1), q(u0, v1, z1)], n: [0, 0, 1] }];
  const vis = faces.filter(f => facesCam(f.n, F));
  const cy = F.y([(u0 + u1) / 2, (v0 + v1) / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2]);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: faces.flatMap(f => f.q), paint: c => { for (const f of vis) { shadeFill(c, f.q, s.col, f.n, s.mat, F, s.alpha);
      if (s.logo && lod < 2 && f.n[2] === 0) { const ctr = [0, 0]; for (const p of f.q) { ctr[0] += p[0] / 4; ctr[1] += p[1] / 4 } const a = f.q[0], b = f.q[1], e = f.q[3], ax = [(b[0] - a[0]) / 2, (b[1] - a[1]) / 2], az = [(e[0] - a[0]) / 2, (e[1] - a[1]) / 2];
        const at = (x, y) => [ctr[0] + ax[0] * x + az[0] * y, ctr[1] + ax[1] * x + az[1] * y]; c.fillStyle = s.logo; poly(c, [at(-.5, -.25), at(.1, -.25), at(.1, -.5), at(.6, 0), at(.1, .5), at(.1, .25), at(-.5, .25)]); c.fill() }
      if (s.stripe && f.n[2] === 0) { const [sc, a0, a1] = s.stripe, a = f.q[0], b = f.q[1], cc = f.q[2], d = f.q[3], L = (p, r, t) => [p[0] + (r[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (r[1] - p[1]) * t];
        const t0 = (a0 - 0) / 1, t1 = a1; c.fillStyle = col(sc, bri(nrm(F.WN(f.n)), MAT.paint)); const zr = z => (z - z0) / (z1 - z0), r0 = zr(z0 + (z1 - z0) * a0), r1 = zr(z0 + (z1 - z0) * a1); poly(c, [L(a, d, r0), L(b, cc, r0), L(b, cc, r1), L(a, d, r1)]); c.fill();
        if (s.stripe2) { const [s2, b0, b1] = s.stripe2; c.fillStyle = col(s2, bri(nrm(F.WN(f.n)), MAT.paint)); poly(c, [L(a, d, b0), L(b, cc, b0), L(b, cc, b1), L(a, d, b1)]); c.fill() } }
      if (s.lightbar && f.n[2] === 0) { const a = f.q[0], b = f.q[1], cc = f.q[2], d = f.q[3], L = (p, r, t) => [p[0] + (r[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (r[1] - p[1]) * t];
        c.fillStyle = '#2f6fff'; poly(c, [L(a, d, .25), L(L(a, b, .48), L(d, cc, .48), .25), L(L(a, b, .48), L(d, cc, .48), .85), L(a, d, .85)]); c.fill(); c.fillStyle = '#ff2a2a'; poly(c, [L(L(a, b, .52), L(d, cc, .52), .25), L(b, cc, .25), L(b, cc, .85), L(L(a, b, .52), L(d, cc, .52), .85)]); c.fill() } }
      c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineWidth = .006 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,10,13,.3)'; for (const f of vis) { c.beginPath(); poly(c, f.q); c.stroke() } } }) }
function tubePieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const pts = s.pts.map(F.P), r = s.r * SCALE, mid = s.pts[Math.floor(s.pts.length / 2)], cy = F.y(mid);
  const dir = nrm(sub(s.pts[s.pts.length - 1], s.pts[0])), sideN = nrm(crs(dir, [0, 0, 1])), nTop = nrm(add([0, 0, 1], mul(sideN, .2)));
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: pts.flatMap(p => [[p[0] - r, p[1] - r], [p[0] + r, p[1] + r]]), paint: c => { c.lineCap = 'round'; c.lineJoin = 'round';
    const line = (w, st) => { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) c.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); c.lineWidth = w; c.strokeStyle = st; c.stroke() };
    line(2 * r + .008 * SCALE, 'rgba(8,10,13,.45)'); line(2 * r, col(s.col, bri(nrm(F.WN(nTop)), s.mat) * .86));
    if (lod < 2 && r * 2 > .014) { c.save(); c.translate(-r * .32, -r * .38); line(r * .7, col(s.col, bri(nrm(F.WN(nTop)), s.mat) * 1.12)); c.restore() } } }) }

function wheelPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const n = 28, axU = s.axis === 'u', zc = s.z0 != null ? s.z0 : s.r, cu = s.u, cv = s.v || 0;
  const at = (a, rr, dv) => axU ? [cu + dv, cv + Math.cos(a) * rr, zc + Math.sin(a) * rr] : [cu + Math.cos(a) * rr, cv + dv, zc + Math.sin(a) * rr];
  const hw = s.w / 2, ringO = [], ringI = [], nAx = axU ? [1, 0, 0] : [0, 1, 0];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = i / n * TAU; ringO.push(F.P(at(a, s.r, hw))); ringI.push(F.P(at(a, s.r, -hw))) }
  const w0 = nrm(F.WN(nAx)), front = (w0[1] * K + w0[2]) >= 0 ? 1 : -1;   
  const faceD = front * hw, cy = F.y([cu, cv, zc]);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: ringO.concat(ringI), paint: c => {
    c.fillStyle = col(s.tyre, .8); poly(c, hull(ringO.concat(ringI))); c.fill();
    if (s.tread && lod < 2) { c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.45)'; c.lineWidth = .02 * SCALE; for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 2) { const a = i / n * TAU, p = F.P(at(a, s.r * 1.0, -hw * .9)), q = F.P(at(a, s.r * 1.0, hw * .9)); c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); c.stroke() } }
    const face = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) face.push(F.P(at(i / n * TAU, s.r * .97, faceD)));
    c.fillStyle = col(s.tyre, bri(mul(w0, front), MAT.rubber) * .95); poly(c, face); c.fill();
    const rr = s.r * (s.rimR || .7), rim = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) rim.push(F.P(at(i / n * TAU, rr, faceD * 1.02)));
    if (s.spokes > 12) {   
      c.strokeStyle = col(s.rim, 1.05); c.lineWidth = .016 * SCALE; poly(c, rim); c.stroke();
      if (lod < 2) { c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,206,212,.75)'; c.lineWidth = .004 * SCALE; c.beginPath(); for (let k = 0; k < s.spokes; k++) { const a = k / s.spokes * TAU, p = F.P(at(a, rr, faceD * .5)), q = F.P(at(a + .3, s.hubR || .04, 0)); c.moveTo(q[0], q[1]); c.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) } c.stroke() }
      const hub = []; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) hub.push(F.P(at(i / 12 * TAU, s.hubR || .04, faceD))); c.fillStyle = col(C.alu, 1); poly(c, hub); c.fill() }
    else { c.fillStyle = col(s.rim, bri(mul(w0, front), MAT.metal)); poly(c, rim); c.fill();
      if (lod < 2) { const hub = [], hr = s.r * .2; for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) hub.push(F.P(at(i / 14 * TAU, hr, faceD * 1.03))); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)';
        for (let k = 0; k < (s.spokes || 5); k++) { const a = k / (s.spokes || 5) * TAU + .3, b = a + TAU / (s.spokes || 5) * .55, P0 = []; for (let t = 0; t <= 4; t++) P0.push(F.P(at(a + (b - a) * t / 4, rr * .86, faceD * 1.03))); for (let t = 4; t >= 0; t--) P0.push(F.P(at(a + (b - a) * t / 4, hr * 1.3, faceD * 1.03))); poly(c, P0); c.fill() }
        c.fillStyle = col(C.alu, 1.1); poly(c, hub); c.fill() }
      if (s.disc && lod < 2) { const dd = []; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) dd.push(F.P(at(i / 16 * TAU, s.r * .45, faceD * 1.05))); c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,206,212,.6)'; c.lineWidth = .012 * SCALE; poly(c, dd); c.stroke() } }
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; c.lineWidth = .006 * SCALE; poly(c, face); c.stroke() } }) }
function blobPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 6; i++) { const ph = -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * i / 6; for (let j = 0; j < 12; j++) { const th = j / 12 * TAU; pts.push(F.P([s.c[0] + s.rad[0] * Math.cos(ph) * Math.cos(th), s.c[1] + s.rad[1] * Math.cos(ph) * Math.sin(th), s.c[2] + s.rad[2] * Math.sin(ph)])) } }
  const H = hull(pts), cy = F.y(s.c), p0 = F.P([s.c[0], s.c[1], s.c[2] + s.rad[2] * .5]);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: H, paint: c => { poly(c, H); let R = 1e-4; for (const p of H) R = Math.max(R, Math.hypot(p[0] - p0[0], p[1] - p0[1])); const g = c.createRadialGradient(p0[0] - R * .2, p0[1] - R * .2, 0, p0[0], p0[1], R * 1.1); g.addColorStop(0, col(s.col, bri([0, 0, 1], s.mat) * 1.1)); g.addColorStop(1, col(s.col, .62)); c.fillStyle = g; c.fill() } }) }
function slabPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const A = s.q.map(F.P), B = s.qb.map(F.P), faces = [{ q: A, n: s.n, c: s.col }, { q: B.slice().reverse(), n: mul(s.n, -1), c: s.inner }];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % 4, e = sub(s.q[j], s.q[i]), nn = nrm(crs(e, s.n)); faces.push({ q: [A[i], A[j], B[j], B[i]], n: nn, c: s.col, edge: 1 }) }
  const c3 = mul(add(add(s.q[0], s.q[1]), add(s.q[2], s.q[3])), .25), cy = F.y(c3);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: A.concat(B), paint: c => { for (const f of faces) { if (!facesCam(f.n, F)) continue; shadeFill(c, f.q, f.c, f.n, s.mat, F) }
    c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineWidth = .006 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,10,13,.34)'; c.beginPath(); poly(c, A); c.stroke() } }) }
function discPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const nn = nrm(s.n), e1 = nrm(Math.abs(nn[2]) > .9 ? crs(nn, [1, 0, 0]) : crs(nn, [0, 0, 1])), e2 = crs(nn, e1), pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i / 16 * TAU; pts.push(F.P(add(s.c, add(mul(e1, Math.cos(a) * s.r), mul(e2, Math.sin(a) * s.r))))) }
  const w = nrm(F.WN(nn)), facing = w[1] * K + w[2] > -.05, cy = F.y(s.c);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias + .002, pts, paint: c => { if (s.ring) { c.fillStyle = s.ring; poly(c, pts); c.fill() } if (!facing && !s.hole) return;
    const P2 = s.ring ? pts.map(p => [p[0] * .78 + F.P(s.c)[0] * .22, p[1] * .78 + F.P(s.c)[1] * .22]) : pts;
    if (s.hole) { c.strokeStyle = col(s.col, 1); c.lineWidth = .025 * SCALE; poly(c, pts); c.stroke(); return }
    c.fillStyle = col(s.col, s.mat && s.mat.glow ? 1.08 : bri(nrm(F.WN(nn)), s.mat)); poly(c, P2); c.fill() } }) }

function parts(type, o) {
  o = o || {}; const M = T[type]; if (!M) throw new Error('W17K: no type ' + type);
  const h = o.h || 0, F = frame(h, 0, 0), lod = o.lod || 0, out = [];
  const S = M.build(Object.assign({}, o));
  for (const D of (M.doors || [])) S.push(...doorSolids(D, o.doors && o.doors[D.id], o.col || M.col0 || '#888'));   
  for (const s of S) { const bias = s.k === 'slab' ? .012 : s.under ? -.24 : s.bar ? -.06 : s.front ? .02 : 0;
    if (s.k === 'prism') prismPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'box') boxPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'tube') { if (lod < 2 || s.r > .012) tubePieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) }
    else if (s.k === 'slab') slabPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'wheel') wheelPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'blob') blobPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'disc') { if (lod < 2 || s.r > .03) discPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) } }
  let riderN = 0;
  if (o.rider && G.P34 && G.P34.parts) { const R = M.rider, lk = Object.assign({}, o.rider, { ride: Object.assign({}, R.ride, o.crank != null && R.ride.crank ? { crank: Object.assign({}, R.ride.crank, { ang: o.crank }) } : {}) });
    const ru = R.u || 0, rv = R.v || 0, sx = (ru * F.cs + rv * F.sn) * SCALE, sy = (ru * F.sn - rv * F.cs) * SCALE, dy = ru * F.sn - rv * F.cs;
    const A = G.P34.parts(lk, { k: 'ride' }, h / (Math.PI / 4), 0, !!o.small, o.plod != null ? o.plod : 2).parts;
    for (const p of A) { if (p.erase) continue; riderN++; out.push({ d: p.d + dy, pts: p.pts.map(q => [q[0] + sx, q[1] + sy]), p34: p, paint: c => { c.save(); c.translate(sx, sy); p.paint(c); if (p.ol && o.olW) ol34(c, p, o.olW); c.restore() } }) } }
  out.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
  let x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9; for (const it of out) for (const p of it.pts) { if (p[0] < x0) x0 = p[0]; if (p[0] > x1) x1 = p[0]; if (p[1] < y0) y0 = p[1]; if (p[1] > y1) y1 = p[1] }
  
  const fp = [], L2 = M.L / 2 * .94, W2 = Math.max(.16, M.W / 2 * (M.kind === 2 ? .45 : .9)), so = Math.min(.55, M.H * .32); for (const [u, v] of [[-L2, -W2], [L2, -W2], [L2, W2], [-L2, W2]]) { const w = F.W([u, v, 0]); fp.push([w[0] * SCALE, w[1] * SCALE]); fp.push([(w[0] + .25 * so) * SCALE, (w[1] + .32 * so) * SCALE]) }
  const shadow = hull(fp); for (const p of shadow) { if (p[0] < x0) x0 = p[0]; if (p[0] > x1) x1 = p[0]; if (p[1] < y0) y0 = p[1]; if (p[1] > y1) y1 = p[1] }
  return { items: out, box: [x0, y0, x1, y1], shadow, riderN, M };
}

function ol34(c, p, w) { try { c.lineWidth = w; const h = p.oc && p.oc[0] === '#' ? p.oc : '#3a3f45'; c.strokeStyle = col(h, .36); c.globalAlpha = .82; c.beginPath();
  if (p.ol === 'side' && p.sA) { const dx = p.sB[0] - p.sA[0], dy = p.sB[1] - p.sA[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dy); if (l > 1e-6) { const nx = -dy / l, ny = dx / l, t = p.olFrom || 0, ax = p.sA[0] + dx * t, ay = p.sA[1] + dy * t, ra = p.ra + (p.rb - p.ra) * t; for (const s of [1, -1]) { c.moveTo(ax + nx * ra * s, ay + ny * ra * s); c.lineTo(p.sB[0] + nx * p.rb * s, p.sB[1] + ny * p.rb * s) } } }
  else p.path(c); c.stroke(); c.globalAlpha = 1 } catch (e) { c.globalAlpha = 1 } }

const mk = (w, h) => { if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'undefined') return new OffscreenCanvas(w, h); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; return c };
function sprite(type, o) { const N = o.N || 32, k = o.k | 0, res = o.res || 1, h = k / N * TAU, pxm = PXM * res, M = T[type];

  const plod = small || rh < 30 ? 0 : rh < 80 ? 1 : 2, olW = plod >= 1 ? Math.min(1.6, .35 + pxm * .0085) / pxm : 0;

  const ox = Math.ceil(-x0 * pxm) + pad, oy = Math.ceil(-y0 * pxm) + pad, W = Math.max(1, ox + Math.ceil(x1 * pxm) + pad), H = Math.max(1, oy + Math.ceil(y1 * pxm) + pad);
  const cv = mk(W, H), c = cv.getContext('2d'); c.setTransform(pxm, 0, 0, pxm, ox, oy); c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineCap = 'round';
  for (const it of R.items) it.paint(c);
  
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(pxm * .0085)), q = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * .7)), t = mk(W, H), g = t.getContext('2d');
  for (const [dx, dy] of [[w, 0], [-w, 0], [0, w], [0, -w], [q, q], [-q, q], [q, -q], [-q, -q]]) g.drawImage(cv, dx, dy);
  g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in'; g.fillStyle = pxm < 40 ? 'rgba(16,20,26,.62)' : 'rgba(16,20,26,.8)'; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-over'; g.setTransform(pxm, 0, 0, pxm, ox, oy); poly(g, R.shadow); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.16)'; g.fill();
  g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; g.drawImage(cv, 0, 0);
  return { cv: t, ox, oy, k, N, res, bytes: W * H * 4, riderN: R.riderN } }

function lamps(type) { const M = T[type]; return M.lamps.map(l => ({ t: l[0], u: l[1] * PXM * SCALE, v: -l[2] * PXM * SCALE, z: l[3] * PXM * SCALE, n: [l[4][0], -l[4][1], l[4][2]], s: l[5] != null ? -l[5] : (l[2] > 0 ? -1 : l[2] < 0 ? 1 : 0), col: l[6] })) }

function drModelById(id, q) { const key = id + '|' + (+q || 1).toFixed(3); let P = DOORS.geo.get(key); if (P !== undefined) return P;

function drDoorsOfW17(asset) { try { if (typeof W17K === 'undefined' || !/^W17-/.test(asset)) return null; const t = asset.slice(4, 6), M = W17K.TYPES[t]; if (!M) return null; const k = 'W17|' + t; let P = DOORS.geo.get(k); if (P !== undefined) return P;

function drSeqStep(dt) { const s = DOORS.seq; if (!s) return; s.t += dt; const T = DOORS.T;
  if ((s.k === 'in' && PlayerProfile.mode !== 'vehicle') || (s.k === 'out' && PlayerProfile.mode !== 'walk') || s.t > 4) { drSeqEnd(); return }
  const toward = (A, B, f) => { s.x = A.x + (B.x - A.x) * f; s.y = A.y + (B.y - A.y) * f; const dx = B.x - A.x, dy = B.y - A.y; if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > .5 && typeof personDirection === 'function') { s.dir = personDirection(dx, dy); s.hd = Math.atan2(dy, dx) } };
  if (s.k === 'in') {
    if (s.ph === 'walk') { const f = Math.min(1, s.t / s.tw); let d = f * s.len; for (let i = 1; i < s.path.length; i++) { const A = s.path[i - 1], B = s.path[i], l = Math.hypot(B.x - A.x, B.y - A.y); if (d <= l || i === s.path.length - 1) { toward(A, B, l > 0 ?       s.mv = true; if (f >= 1) { s.ph = 'open'; s.t0 = s.t; s.mv = false; if (s.di >= 0) drSet('PLAYER-CAR', s.di, 1, T.plOpen, 'pl', s.ids); else { s.ph = 'in' } } return }
    if (s.ph === 'open') { if (s.t - s.t0 >= T.plOpen) { s.ph = 'in'; s.t0 = s.t } return }
    if (s.ph === 'in') { const f = Math.min(1, (s.t - s.t0) / T.plIn); toward(s.S, s.I, f); s.al = 1 - f; s.mv = false; if (f >= 1) { s.ph = 'close'; s.t0 = s.t; if (s.di >= 0) drSet('PLAYER-CAR', s.di, 0, T.plClose, 'pl', s.ids); else { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } } return }
    if (s.ph === 'close') { if (s.t - s.t0 >= T.plClose) { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } return } }
  else {
    if (s.ph === 'open') { if (s.t >= (s.di >= 0 ? T.plOpen : 0)) { s.ph = 'out'; s.t0 = s.t } return }
    if (s.ph === 'out') { const f = Math.min(1, (s.t - s.t0) / T.plIn); toward(s.I, s.S, f); s.al = f; if (f >= 1) { s.ph = 'close'; s.t0 = s.t; PlayerPed.x = s.S.x; PlayerPed.y = s.S.y; if (s.di >= 0) drSet('PLAYER-CAR', s.di, 0, T.plClose, 'pl', s.ids); else { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } } return }
    if (s.ph === 'close') { if (s.t - s.t0 >= T.plClose) { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } return } } }

function drClStep(dt) { const T = DOORS.T, L = DOORS.cl; for (let i = L.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const e = L[i]; e.t += dt; let done = false;
